win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 14. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: Wheel of Fortune
wilds.behavior:
When the Wheel of Fortune-symbol lands it triggers the Wheel of Fortune feature with 1 - 3 spins. Each spin can award various features which are then applied to the grid. After the feature is complete, the Wheel of Fortune-symbol turns into a WILD symbol.

 In the BASE GAME the Wheel of Fortune can spawn wilds, upgrade low-paying symbols to a high-paying symbol, award a Global Multiplier or add Cash Prizes. In the BONUS GAME it can also award additional free spins.

multipliers.name: Global Multiplier
multipliers.behavior: Activates a Global Multiplier with 2x, 3x or 5x, boosting all wins for the current spin. If multiple Global Multiplier features are awarded, they get added together. In the BONUS GAME the multiplier remains until the end of the round.

collectors.name: Cash Prizes
collectors.behavior:
Cash Prizes are dollar bills with fixed values. They are added behind the symbols and are collected when a winning combination occurs on the positions that hold Cash Prizes.

 The values are: 2x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 250x, 500x and 1000x.

 In the BONUS GAME the Cash Prizes remain sticky until the end of the round.

 If additional Cash Prizes occur, they will be applied to any unoccupied spots on the grid, ensuring no overlap or replacement of existing prizes

specials.name: Symbol Upgrade
specials.behavior: Upgrades all low-paying symbols to a new, randomly selected high-paying symbol for the current spin.

modes.name: Extra Free Spins
modes.effects: Awards 2-5 additional free spins in the BONUS GAME.

modes.name: BONUS GAME
modes.trigger: landing 3, 4 or 5 BONUS scatter symbols at the same time during the BASE GAME.
modes.effects:
Trigger the BONUS GAME with 10, 12 or 14 free spins by landing 3, 4 or 5 BONUS scatter symbols at the same time during the BASE GAME.

 During the BONUS GAME, the Wheel of Fortune feature activates more frequently. The Global Multiplier and Cash Prizes remain through the BONUS GAME. Cash Prizes disappear after being collected.

 The Wheel of Fortune can also award additional free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The BONUS symbol does not appear during the BONUS GAME.
 WILD symbols substitute for all symbols in the paytable and appear in both the BASE GAME and BONUS GAME.
 Wheel of Fortune-symbols appear in both the BASE GAME and BONUS GAME.
